edit_text_index.html_2: Serving and protecting the southern portion of Montgomery Township with unwavering dedication, courage, and pride.
edit_text_index.html_4: Montgomery Township Volunteer Fire Company #2 is an all-volunteer organization dedicated to protecting the lives and property of the residents of Montgomery Township and surrounding communities.
edit_text_index.html_6: Important details about our firehouse operations, locations, and annual call statistics.
edit_text_index.html_13: Stay connected with us on social media for live incident updates, crew photos, and community events.
edit_text_index.html_15: Montgomery Township Volunteer Fire Company #2 is an all-volunteer, 501(c)(3) non-profit organization. Your generous donations help us continue to protect lives and property.
edit_text_index.html_17: Unlike career fire departments, we rely on the generosity of our community members, businesses, and municipal support to fund our daily operations and equipment. Your contributions directly fund:
edit_text_index.html_18: Protective Gear: Outfitting a single volunteer firefighter with bunker gear, helmet, boots, and SCBA respirator costs over $10,000.
edit_text_index.html_19: Rescue Tools: Thermal cameras, gas meters, hydraulic vehicle extrication tools, and swift water rescue equipment.
edit_text_index.html_20: Continuous Training: Regular drills, fire academy certification courses, and specialized rescue training.
edit_text_index.html_22: Donate safely and securely online using PayPal, Debit, or Credit Card.
edit_text_index.html_24: We are always looking for driven individuals to join our family. Whether you are 16 or 60, there is a role for you.
